_note: SATURATED companion to validate_apr6_h100.json, same H100:1 fleet and window. time_scale=0.25 (4x the production arrival rate; time_scale multiplies inter-arrival delays, so smaller = heavier load). Purpose: the ts=1.0 run measured queueing delay at a p50 of 0.5 ms -- the H100 fleet simply never queues on this trace -- so the cost model's queue term had nothing to be validated against. This run drives the fleet past its admission capacity so Q becomes observable, and pooled with the ts=1.0 run it gives a load sweep for the by-load calibration buckets. Replay is ~8 minutes at this scale.
